comparison.objective: Reattach a detached live wrist camera by sliding its shoe into a wrist channel and engaging retention.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual self-maintenance, channel alignment, sliding insertion, end-stop seating, and latch engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Camera reaches the original optical pose, enters and seats in the channel, latches, continues live delivery, and remains secured after release.
comparison.reason: This is the closest geometric neighbor because it tests aligned sliding insertion and retention. It nevertheless tests mounting one captive shoe into a latching channel; it does not require maintaining a separate jig in physical end-face contact while transferring an uncaged recirculating block or preventing multiple free balls from escaping. Candidate gap, angular, and force limits are still prototype assumptions, but its defining tested ability remains meaningfully different.
